services_overview.heading: The complete finishing package for high end homes.
services_overview.intro: Builders hand us whole finishing scopes, and homeowners come to us for kitchens, built ins and wood interiors. Every scope is run on site by our own family crew, led by a Red Seal carpenter.

cards.title: Complete Finishing Packages
cards.text: Hand us the whole finishing scope, outside and in, and take it off your plate.

cards.title: Exterior Cladding and Interior Millwork

process.heading: From first conversation to final walkthrough.
process.intro: Every project follows the same real customer journey, whether it's a full custom home or a single-room renovation.

steps.title: Vision
steps.text: We start by listening: how you want to live in the space and what the project needs to achieve.

steps.title: Collaboration
steps.text: Your ideas and our trade experience come together early, before anything is locked in on paper.

steps.title: Concept
steps.text: Layout, massing, and material direction take shape as an early concept for you to react to.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: The concept becomes detailed drawings. In house 3D modelling keeps every decision visual.

steps.title: Planning
steps.text: Permitting, scheduling, and budgeting are locked down before a single crew shows up on-site.

steps.title: Execution
steps.text: Our own crew builds it, led on site every day by a Red Seal carpenter.

steps.title: Finishing
steps.text: Trim, millwork, and the fine details that separate a good build from a photographed one.

steps.title: Cleaning
steps.text: The site is cleaned and prepped for a final walkthrough. Ready to move in, not just ready to leave.

steps.title: Goodbyes
steps.text: Final handover and walkthrough. For most clients, it's the start of a relationship we hear from again.

items.question: What does Renova Design Build do?
items.answer: We take on the complete finishing package for high end homes: exterior cedar cladding and hemlock soffits, interior millwork, cabinetry, doors, trim and stairs, plus architectural concrete like formed stairs, retaining walls and planters. We also design and build kitchens, built ins and wood interiors for homeowners.

items.question: Who's actually on my job site?
items.answer: Our own family crew. A partner is on site for the start, the key decisions and the finishing, and the person who quotes your job is the person running it.

items.question: Do you work for builders or homeowners?
items.answer: Both. Builders hand us whole finishing scopes so they can take them off their plate, and homeowners hire us to design and build directly. Homeowner projects start at $25K.

items.question: Are you licensed and insured?
items.answer: Yes. Full WorkSafeBC coverage and liability insurance, with Red Seal Journeyman Carpenters leading every project.

items.question: Do you provide 3D drawings before construction starts?
items.answer: Yes. We model the project in SketchUp with you so every decision is visual before anything is built.

items.question: What areas do you serve?
items.answer: We're based in Surrey, BC. Serving Metro Vancouver, the North Shore, the Fraser Valley, the Sunshine Coast and Sea to Sky.
